stemMd: Once indispensable, the instrument has been replaced by cheaper and more accurate tools and is now largely ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Replacement by superior alternatives makes the old instrument obsolete or outmoded. Both fit the temporal contrast, whereas physical design properties are unsupported.

distractorRationale.a: Size and mobility are not discussed.
distractorRationale.d: The instrument is described as formerly indispensable.
distractorRationale.f: Complexity does not follow from replacement.
distractorRationale.c: This conflicts with its replacement by newer tools.
